title: Accrual status changed
description: This event is generated when an account's accrual status changes. For more information, refer to Accrual status changed event flows.

balance_due.title: Balance due
balance_due.description: `current_balance` of the first statement where the account became overdue or entered refinancing. (That is, when `account_status` changed to `OVERDUE_STARTED` or `REFINANCING_STARTED`.)

open_due_date.title: Open due date
open_due_date.description: Real due date for the first statement where the account became overdue

amount_paid.title: Amount paid
amount_paid.description: Amount paid. This field only appears if a payment triggered the event. This is the case when `account_status` equals `REFINANCING_CHANGE`, `OVERDUE_STOP`, `REFINANCING_STOP`, or `OVERDUE_UNDERPAID`.

credit_transaction_id.title: Credit transaction ID
credit_transaction_id.description: Credit transaction ID. This field only appears if a payment triggered the event. This is the case when `account_status` equals `REFINANCING_CHANGE`, `OVERDUE_STOP`, `REFINANCING_STOP`, or `OVERDUE_UNDERPAID`.
